# opnsense_haproxy_mailer (Resource)

HAProxy e-mail alerts (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ E-Mail Alerts**, plugin `os-haproxy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_mailer" "ops" {
  name        = "ops"
  mailservers = ["192.0.2.25:25"]
  sender      = "haproxy@example.com"
  recipient   = "ops@example.com"
  loglevel    = "alert"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mailservers` (Set of String) Add mailservers to this mailer configuration, i.e. 192.168.1.1:25. Use TAB key to complete typing.
- `name` (String) Choose a name for this mailer configuration.
- `recipient` (String) Declare both the recipient address in the envelope and to address in the header of email alerts.
- `sender` (String) Declare the from email address to be used in both the envelope and header of email alerts.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Choose a optional description for this mailer configuration. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this mailer configuration. Defaults to `true`.
- `hostname` (String) Declare the to hostname address to be used when communicating with mailers. Defaults to ``.
- `loglevel` (String) Declare the maximum log level of messages for which email alerts will be sent. This acts as a filter on the sending of email alerts. One of `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`. Defaults to `alert`.
- `timeout` (String) Defines the time (in seconds) available for a mail/connection to be made and send to the mail server. Defaults to `30`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the e-mail alert.
